answer: An ember kiln fires once an epoch; only 24 open on one trellis. Each identity locks 85 POA, +40 per extra identity from one root: ten fakes lock 2,650 POA. The firing curve is seeded by the last block plus the key, in one shared 20-minute window; the operator stokes the hollow vessel live, answering three curve points. One operator tends two kilns at most, so ten fakes need five hands and thirty live answers at once. A missed stoke burns 25 POA; a replayed curve matches twice and both bonds burn. The chain checks curve times against funding roots: one hand, ten kilns, one identity.
